lines: Forty years later... everyone you love has *grey hair*. You don't.
Cities rise and fall around you. Wooden carts become cars. Cars become flying machines. You just keep walking.
Lyra grows old on a park bench. She still laughs at your jokes, slowly. But she asks: *how are you not tired*?
She is gone by spring. You keep her scarf. It is the only thing that ages with you.
Then an old woman taps your shoulder and whispers: I have been waiting *four hundred years* for you.
Follow and comment... for part three!
